Statement: rolling_window_dag gives each node up to N immediately preceding nodes as parents. It is a benchmark shape, not a clinical DAG.
Uniform synthetic CPT values are used. They have no clinical interpretation; only computational behaviour is measured.
PythonPeakAllocatedMiB is tracemalloc peak allocation during model construction and inference initialisation, not total container RSS.
SerializedModelMiB is a Python pickle size for the pgmpy model, not a storage-format recommendation.
VariableElimination latency is meaningful only with the recorded topology, parent count and state cardinality.
